sentences.text: Unknown vs Xv Additional District Judge on 5 December, 2025
HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH AT AMARAVATI  MAIN CASE No.:W.P.No.33938 of 2025  PROCEEDING SHEET SL. OFFICE

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH AT AMARAVATI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: NOTE HCJ &05.12.2025  RSR, J DR, J  Heard the learned counsel for the  petitioner.
The writ petition is filed aggrieved by the  order dated 29.08.2025 passed by the learned
XV Additional District Judge, Krishna  District at Nuzvid, in L.A.O.P. No.15 of 2017

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Krishna  District at Nuzvid
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
. 
 Respondent No.1 herein was appointed as the competent authority for the purpose of acquiring land and determining compensation.
Based on the recommendations of the Horticulture and Forest Departments, the competent authority assessed and fixed the value of the trees and crops standing in the subject property.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner had acquired land admeasuring Ac.0.65 cents in Sy.No.160/1B2 of Sunnampadu Village of G. Konduru Mandal, Krishna District from the 2nd respondent, and that the assessing authority initially awarded a certain amount towards compensation for the subject property.

After SL. OFFICE DATE ORDER No. NOTE receiving the said compensation, the 2nd respondent, being dissatisfied with the quantum awarded,
preferred L.A.O.P. No.15 of 2017 before the District Court under Section 10(1), (2), (3)(i), (ii) and (iii) of the Petroleum and Mineral Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962.

entities.text: Petroleum and Mineral Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Subsequently, the District Court enhanced the compensation to an amount of Rs.21,85,000/-.

It is contended that such enhancement is not supported by any fixed or approved valuation, and that the award passed by the learned District Judge is not in accordance with the proper valuation methodology.

Considering the submissions, there shall be a stay of all further proceedings pursuant to the order dated 29.08.2025 passed by the learned XV Additional District Judge, Krishna District at Nuzvid, in L.A.O.P. No.15 of 2017.

entities.text: XV Additional District Judge, Krishna District at Nuzvid
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to take out personal notice to the respondent No.2 through RPAD and file proof of service before the registry.
